title: Flask's implicit int converter needs an explicit Zod schema in Hono.
body: Flask's `<int:id>` route converter 404s on non-numeric input automatically. Hono has no equivalent, so every ported route needs an explicit `z.coerce.number().int()` validator or the 404 behavior silently changes to a 500.

title: Hono's json() helper does not set charset=utf-8 by default.
body: `c.json(body)` in Hono sets `Content-Type: application/json` without a charset. Flask's `jsonify` sets `application/json` too, so this is actually parity -- but clients that inferred UTF-8 from Flask's `mimetype` should not assume it here either.

title: run_hono_smoke_test
body: Starts a local Hono server and exercises each route once, with response-shape assertions.

title: Port Flask service to TypeScript/Hono -- completed
body: Ported 6 routes across 5 steps; 1 retry on POST /profile for validation parity. Smoke suite green. Recorded 1 lesson and 1 gotcha.
